name: MUQ SEO Site Checker
author: Mizbahuddin Qasim

sections.description:
MUQ SEO Site Checker is a technical site health inspection and audit tool for WordPress. It analyzes your website’s on-page structure, metadata, and server configurations to identify technical issues and assist with search engine discovery.

The plugin provides actionable diagnostics across your pages, helping webmasters inspect structured data, configure instant indexing pings, monitor 404 errors, and maintain clean URL redirections.

Key Capabilities

  • Site Health Diagnostics: Inspect over 50 technical checkpoints covering meta tags, headings, content length, and page metadata with an organized diagnostic score.
  • Metadata & Image Tagging: Identify and resolve missing image alternative (ALT) attributes, page descriptions, and Open Graph tags.
  • Structured Data (Schema JSON-LD): Generate standard Schema.org microdata (Organization, WebSite, LocalBusiness, Article, Product) and build interactive FAQs with FAQPage markup.
  • Search Engine Notification (IndexNow): Send automated publish pings to participating search engines (such as Bing and Yandex) via the IndexNow protocol.
  • URL Redirects & 404 Logging: Track incoming 404 requests and configure 301, 302, and 410 URL redirects with regex pattern support.
  • AI Search Standard (/llms.txt): Generate markdown-formatted /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt files to guide AI web crawlers.
  • Bulk Content Utilities: Review and update missing image attributes and meta descriptions across existing posts from a centralized screen.
  • XML Sitemaps & Directives: Generate native XML sitemaps and configure virtual robots.txt crawler directives.
  • Privacy Focused: No third-party scripts loaded by default, minimal resource usage, and built strictly with native WordPress APIs.

External Services

This plugin optionally connects to the following external services. All connections are user-initiated and require explicit configuration by the site administrator.

Google PageSpeed Insights API

When you add a Google PageSpeed API key in Settings, the plugin queries the PageSpeed Insights API to retrieve performance scores for your pages.

  • Data sent: The public URL of the page being analyzed.
  • Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

IndexNow API (Bing / Yandex)

When IndexNow is enabled by the administrator, the plugin sends a URL ping to https://api.indexnow.org/indexnow whenever a post is published or updated, to notify search engines of new content. IndexNow is disabled by default and must be explicitly enabled in Settings.

  • Data sent: The public URL of the updated post and your site’s IndexNow API key.
  • IndexNow FAQ / Terms: https://www.indexnow.org/faq
  • Bing Privacy Policy: https://privacy.microsoft.com/en-us/privacystatement

Google & Bing Sitemap Ping

When “Search Engine Auto-Ping” is explicitly enabled in Settings > Sitemaps, the plugin sends a GET ping request to Google (https://www.google.com/ping) and Bing (https://www.bing.com/ping) whenever a post or page is published, providing the public URL of your sitemap index. This feature is disabled by default and requires explicit user activation.

  • Data sent: The public XML sitemap index URL of your website.
  • Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Bing / Microsoft Privacy Policy: https://privacy.microsoft.com/en-us/privacystatement

Google Gemini AI

When you enter a Google Gemini API key in Settings > AI and enable AI features, the plugin sends post content to the Gemini API to generate SEO suggestions. When the AI-generated ALT text feature is enabled, image files may also be sent to Gemini Vision for analysis.

  • Data sent: Post title, content, focus keyword, and optionally image data (thumbnail) for ALT text generation.
  • Google AI Privacy Policy: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms
  • Google Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms

OpenAI

When you enter an OpenAI API key in Settings > AI and select OpenAI as the provider, the plugin sends post content to the OpenAI API. When the AI-generated ALT text feature is enabled, image files may also be sent to OpenAI Vision for analysis.

  • Data sent: Post title, content, focus keyword, and optionally image data (thumbnail) for ALT text generation.
  • OpenAI Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
  • OpenAI Terms of Use: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use
sections.installation:
1. Upload the muq-seo-site-checker folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to MUQ SEO Site Checker in your WordPress admin menu to run your first inspection.
sections.faq:
Does MUQ SEO Site Checker conflict with third-party SEO plugins?

No. MUQ SEO Site Checker detects third-party plugins (like Yoast SEO or Rank Math) and automatically avoids outputting duplicate meta descriptions or Open Graph social tags.

What does this plugin inspect?

MUQ SEO Site Checker analyzes technical on-page elements, structured data schemas, server redirects, and tracking code configuration, providing clear diagnostic summaries and tools to correct technical errors.

How does it help site accessibility and standards?

It highlights missing image ALT text for screen readers, ensures valid JSON-LD schema syntax, and monitors broken links to keep site navigation clean.

What is llms.txt?

llms.txt is an open standard file served at yoursite.com/llms.txt that provides Large Language Models (LLMs) and search crawlers with markdown-formatted information about your website.

Does this plugin load external fonts or scripts?

No external scripts are loaded by default. Chart.js is bundled locally. All assets are loaded locally from your own server.

Does it use AI features?

The plugin supports the native WordPress 7.0 Core AI Client out of the box, routing through whichever provider is configured centrally under Settings > Connectors. For sites on earlier WordPress versions, optional direct integration with Google Gemini or OpenAI is supported. AI features are entirely opt-in and disabled by default.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Removed arbitrary .htaccess editor to comply with WordPress.org security policies.
  • Extracted inline sitemap XSL styles to external stylesheet.
  • Enhanced late output escaping across templates and breadcrumb engine.
  • Fixed SVG filter helper functions across admin navigation.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
  • Added On-Page SEO, Schema, Sitemaps, and Redirection inspection engines.
  • Added 1-Click Fix Center for image ALT attributes, meta descriptions, and Open Graph tags.
  • Added AI Search /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt standard generator and route handler.
  • Added secure CSV export and historical trend reporting.
